title: WWF Terrestrial Ecoregions of the World (2017 update)
description: Global terrestrial ecoregions from the World Wildlife Fund (WWF), based on the landmark Olson et al. (2001) classification. The dataset delineates 847 ecoregions grouped into 14 biomes and 9 biogeographic realms. Each ecoregion represents a distinct community of plants and animals sharing evolutionary history. The 2017 revision incorporates the Nature Needs Half (NNH) index, which categorizes each ecoregion by its current level of nature protection and potential for recovery. Available as GeoParquet for analysis, PMTiles for web mapping, H3 hexagonal parquet (resolution 8) for spatial joins, and the original GDB source.

ecoregion-parquet.title: GeoParquet — 847 global terrestrial ecoregions
ecoregion-parquet.description: Cloud-native GeoParquet with polygon geometries in EPSG:4326. One row per ecoregion.

ecoregion-pmtiles.title: PMTiles for web mapping
ecoregion-pmtiles.description: Pyramid of map tiles for efficient web map rendering.

ecoregion-hex.title: H3 hex-indexed parquet files (resolution 8)
ecoregion-hex.description: Parquet files partitioned by H3 resolution-0 cell (h0, INTEGER encoding). H3 resolution 8 (~0.74 km² cells). Each row is one ecoregion × H3 cell intersection.

gdb.title: Original ESRI File Geodatabase
gdb.description: Original source GDB as provided by WWF.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Original object ID from the source GDB.

table:columns.name: ECO_NAME
table:columns.description: Full name of the ecoregion (e.g., 'Amazon River and Flooded Forests'). Unique per ecoregion.

table:columns.name: BIOME_NUM
table:columns.description: Biome numeric code (1–14). See BIOME_NAME for labels.

table:columns.name: BIOME_NAME
table:columns.description: Biome name. One of 14 terrestrial biome types (e.g., 'Tropical & Subtropical Moist Broadleaf Forests', 'Tundra', 'Deserts & Xeric Shrublands').

table:columns.name: REALM
table:columns.description: Biogeographic realm. One of: Afrotropic, Antarctica, Australasia, Indomalayan, Nearctic, Neotropic, Oceania, Palearctic.

table:columns.name: ECO_BIOME_
table:columns.description: Combined ecoregion–biome code identifier.

table:columns.name: NNH
table:columns.description: Nature Needs Half index numeric code (1–4). See NNH_NAME for labels.

table:columns.name: NNH_NAME
table:columns.description: Nature Needs Half category: 'Half Protected' (≥50% protected), 'Nature Could Reach Half Protected' (<50% protected but recoverable), 'Nature Could Recover' (degraded but restorable), 'Nature Imperiled' (heavily converted).

table:columns.name: ECO_ID
table:columns.description: Unique numeric ecoregion identifier.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_LENG
table:columns.description: Perimeter length in original CRS units.

table:columns.name: COLOR
table:columns.description: Hex color code for ecoregion cartographic display.

table:columns.name: COLOR_BIO
table:columns.description: Hex color code for biome-level cartographic display.

table:columns.name: COLOR_NNH
table:columns.description: Hex color code for Nature Needs Half category display.

table:columns.name: LICENSE
table:columns.description: License string. Always 'CC-BY 4.0'.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Perimeter length (duplicate of SHAPE_LENG from GDB conversion).

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Area in original CRS units (degrees²). Use geometry for accurate area calculations in projected CRS.

table:columns.name: SHAPE
table:columns.description: Geometry in WKB format, EPSG:4326 (WGS84). MultiPolygon.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the ecoregion polygon in EPSG:4326.

table:columns.name: h8
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 8 (~0.74 km² cells), INTEGER encoding. Present only in hex parquet, not in GeoParquet.

table:columns.name: h0
table:columns.description: H3 cell index at resolution 0, INTEGER encoding. Partition key. Present only in hex parquet.
